concepts.name: 停靠槽
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: ONE minimalist macOS app icon for DockShell, a native SSH terminal application. Create an ORIGINAL independent visual direction, not a concept board or multiple icons.
Style: flat precision geometric logo, modern and minimal, medium-bold strokes, 1–3 major elements maximum, balanced negative space, clear at 24–32 px. Absolutely NO gradients, texture, gloss, bevels, reflections, shadows, glow, glass or 3D. No text, wordmark, captions, labels or numerals in the image. No copying existing application logos or commercial artwork.
Composition: one front-facing centered rounded-square icon tile occupying about 82% of a square canvas, with genuine transparent margins outside the tile. Central mark uses roughly 50–60% of tile width with generous breathing room. Keep all artwork inside the tile. One single icon only.
Avoid: locks, shields, keys, commercial terminal window motifs, screenshots, traffic-light dots, computer devices, decorative borders, watermarks or presentation mockups.
Palette: solid charcoal teal #142229 tile, off-white #F3F7F6 and muted mint #67DCC1 symbol.
Exact concept: A compact bold U-shaped docking berth, with one short mint horizontal bar suspended inside its opening. Only two geometric elements. The U has a flat bottom, open top, softly rounded joins. Reads as an arriving cursor docking into a terminal. Strong balanced silhouette.
Transparent outside the rounded-square tile.
